blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover reference equivalence on randomized and large databases, but they do not explicitly enforce the stated deterministic CPU-time/per-request-work budget or directly exercise every named boundary and CLI-contract case; performance is only indirectly constrained by the overall verifier timeout.

valid_failure_modes: The stated performance requirement is not given a deterministic test-level budget, so implementations may pass or fail based on machine speed and the broad verifier timeout rather than a clear performance criterion.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs and caches pytest during image construction, while pytest is a verifier-only dependency and should be isolated to the test setup rather than baked into the runtime image.
